_comment: Copy to integration_config.json and fill in. That file holds API keys, so
bot_config points at the config the bot under test is RUNNING with. The
script reads the gain matrix, master data and both competition dates from
it, so they cannot drift out of sync with what it asserts.
The two students must be regular user accounts, not bots: `no submits`
filters bots out, so a bot student makes that assertion meaningless. Give
them the same display_name if you also want to exercise the namesake
The teacher may be your own account, and must appear in the bot config's
